author: NicoBellicRules
quote: As you can see from my past reviews, I am the biggest GTA fan there is.   GTA 4 might be my favorite game of all time.  GTA 5 was excellent.  GTA 6 is visually stunning, but otherwise it is absolutely horrible and nothing but a feminist-insert game.  Simply put, this is a game made by feminists for feminists, and it is sickening.  I cannot believe Rockstar did this.  The only reason why this has done so well in sales is that you can't return the game.  The game is lifeless, soulless, and just flat-out boring.  I am very disappointed in this game, and it is all because leftist politics are being inserted into gaming.  Keep politics out of gaming!  Stop with the activist slants!  Just tell a good story!

author: NicoBellicRules
quote: This is a good game.  I enjoyed it.  I do not like the subtle leftist takes in the game though, but it wasn't too much.  Definitely worth picking up on Steam --- especially during their sales.

author: NicoBellicRules
quote: Great game.  My recommendation is this.  Play Sniper Elite 2 and then play the zombie army trilogy.  It is so neat to see all the places before and after the zombie event.  Absolutely great games.  If you wait for a Steam sale, you can get both pretty cheap too.  You will have a month of fun and great memories.  The entire Sniper Elite series is worth the money.

author: NicoBellicRules
quote: You cannot go wrong with any of the Sniper Elite games and also the **** Zombie Army Trilogy.  My only complaint is I wish they were longer because I want to keep playing more.  I highly recommend playing Sniper Elite 2 first.  Then the **** Zombie Army Trilogy.  Then, 3 and 4.

author: NicoBellicRules
quote: Absolutely great game.  I wish it was longer though.  You can also play this well on a low-end PC.  I highly recommend it.  I got it on sale on Steam.  It sure beats going to the movies.  I got 30 hours of great gameplay out of it.

author: NicoBellicRules
quote: This is probably the best game I have ever played.  I waffle back and forth between this and GTA IV.  I highly suggest that you also upload your favorite songs in the game.  On the PC, this is very easy to do.  All you have to do is move your favorite MP3 files to a folder.  My only complaint is that Rockstar should have expanded the single player game.  I could have played 20 more missions.  That is how great this game is.

author: NicoBellicRules
quote: The game play is absolutely awesome in this game.  You can totally immerse yourself in the game.  My only complaint is I feel like the story was half a story.  Had they made a game with a complete end to end story that was serious, this would have been one of the best games in history.  It is still worth buying and playing though.  I had actually returned from the hospital and had to spend a week or so in bed and this is the game I played.  Don't laugh, but it made going to the hospital one of the highlights of my life.  The painkillers didn't hurt either.
game_title: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain

author: NicoBellicRules
quote: This is the game that got me back into gaming.  The story is awesome, and you will really relate to Niko Bellic.  Also, the two other companion games (The Lost and the Damned / Ballad of Gay Tony) are great as well.  All three games actually work together to tell a full story.  I used an excel spreadsheet and was able to play all three games at once as if it was one complete story.  That was extremely interesting because of the different points of views, and you also cover every inch of the GTA world that way.  GTA 4 and 5 are simply two of my top 5 videos games.  That is how good they are.

author: NicoBellicRules
quote: Absolutely worth the money.  The storyline will keep you interested, and the game play is fun.  I highly recommend it and you can get it for cheap on Steam.  If you get it during a sale, it is well worth the money.  It sure beats going to the movies nowadays.
